lastPrice.def: This is the close price from the day stock last traded

pr1d.def: This is the percentage change in the company's stock price over the previous day

pr1w.def: This is the percentage change in the company's stock price over the previous week

4wpct.def: This is the percentage change in the company's stock price over the previous 4 weeks

26wpct.def: This is the percentage change in the company's stock price over the previous 26 weeks

52wpct.def: This is the percentage change in the company's stock price over the previous 52 weeks

pr1wN.def: % change in the company's stock price minus % change in the Nifty over the previous week

4wpctN.def: % change in the company's stock price minus % change in the Nifty over the previous 4 weeks

6mpctN.def: % change in the company's stock price minus % change in the Nifty over the previous 26 weeks

12mpctN.def: % change in the company's stock price minus % change in the Nifty over the previous 52 weeks

52whd.def: 52W high price divided by the close price minus one

52wld.def: Close price divided by the 52W low price minus one

acVol.def: This is the traded volume from the day stock last traded

vol1dChPct.def: This is the percentage change in stocks volume over the previous day

vol1wChPct.def: This is the percentage change in stock's volume over the previous week

vol1mAvg.def: Average of daily volume of stocks traded over the past 4 weeks

vol3mAvg.def: Average of daily volume of stocks traded over the past 13 weeks

faceValue.def: Original cost of the stock as decided by the company at the time of issue

5yCagrPct.def: Compounded annual growth rate of stock price over previous 5 years

roe.def: Net income divided by the average common equity for the most recent financial year

5Yroe.def: Average of annual return on equity for the five most recent financial years

rtnAsts.def: Net income divided by the average total assets for the most recent financial year

5YrtnAsts.def: Average of annual return on assets for the five most recent financial years

pftMrg.def: Net income divided by the revenue earned for the most recent financial year

5YpftMrg.def: Average of annual net profit margin for the five most recent financial years

aroi.def: Net income divided by the average of total debt and total equity

5Yaroi.def: Average of annual return on investment for the five most recent financial years

aopm.def: EBITDA divided by the revenue earned for the most recent financial year

opmg.def: Average of annual EBITDA margin for the five most recent financial years

balCogs.def: Refers to the direct cost of producing goods sold by the company. This usually includes raw material and labour cost expended to produce the good.

cafCfoaMgn.def: Cash from operations divided by total revenue for the most recent financial year

5YcafCfoaMgn.def: Average of annual cash flow margin for the 5 most recent financial years

roce.def: Return on Capital Employed. EBIT divided by capital employed, ie total assets minus total current liabilities for the most recent financial year

ldbtEqt.def: Total long term debt divided by the total shareholder equity

dbtEqt.def: Total debt divided by the total shareholder equity

aqui.def: Total current assets minus total inventory divided by the total current liabilities

qcur.def: Total current assets divided by the total current liabilities

ccnc.def: Sum of the avg inventory days & avg receivables collection days minus avg payable payment period

aint.def: Ratio of earnings before interest and taxes divided by the interest expense

invTurnR.def: Cost of goods sold of a company divided by average inventory over the past 2 financial years

asstTurnR.def: Total revenue of a company divided by average total assets over the past 2 financial years

daysOfInvOstndng.def: Average number of days a company holds inventory before turning it into sales

daysSalesOstndng.def: Average number of days a company takes to realise payment of a sale

daysPayOstndng.def: Average number of days a company takes to make payments to its trade creditors.

wcTurnR.def: Total revenue of a company divided by average working capital over the past 2 financial years

netIncByLbl.def: Net income divided by total liabilities for the most recent financial year

erngPwrR.def: EBIT divided by total assets for the most recent financial year

estrvng.def: Estimated revenue for the current financial year divided by the revenue for the last financial year minus one

rvng.def: Revenue for the last financial year divided by the revenue for the financial year before that minus one

5YrevChg.def: The annual compounded growth rate of revenue over the last 5 years

estAvg.def: Estimated EBITDA for the current financial year divided by the EBITDA for the last financial year minus one

ebitg.def: EBITDA for the last financial year divided by the EBITDA for the financial year before that minus one

earnings.def: The annual compounded growth rate of EBITDA over the last 5 years

12mEpsg.def: Estimated EPS for the current financial year divided by the EPS for the last financial year minus one

epsg.def: EPS for the last financial year divided by the EPS for the financial year before that minus one

epsGwth.def: The annual compounded growth rate of EPS, excluding extraordinary items,  over the last 5 years

ecfog.def: Estimated cash flow from operations (CFO) for the current financial year divided by the CFO for the last financial year minus one

cfog.def: Actual cash flow from operations (CFO) for the last financial year divided by the CFO for the financial year before that minus one

cfotr.def: The annual compounded growth rate of CFO, excluding extraordinary items,  over the last 5 years

3YdivGwth.def: Compound annual growth rate in dividends per share calculated for 3 years

apef.def: Close price divided by the earnings per share, excluding extraordinary items, for the most recent financial year

pef.def: Close price divided by the estimated EPS for the current financial year

ped.def: Stock PE ratio divided by the corresponding sector PE ratio minus one

pbr.def: Close price divided by the book value per share at the end of the most recent financial year

pbd.def: Stock PB ratio divided by the corresponding sector PB ratio minus one

divDps.def: Dividend Per Share for the most recent financial year divided by the close price

divSec.def: Difference between the dividend yield of company and the corresponding sector

ps.def: Close price divided by the revenue per share for the most recent financial year

psf.def: Close price divided by the estimated revenue per share for the most recent financial year

psfs.def: Stock PS ratio divided by the corresponding sector PS ratio minus one

evebitd.def: Enterprise Value divided by the EBITDA for the most recent financial year

ev.def: Sum of a company’s latest market capitalisation, total debt and minority interest minus cash and short term investments at the end of the most recent financial year

evebit.def: Current Enterprise Value divided by the EBIT at the end of the most recent financial year

evByRev.def: Current Enterprise Value divided by the total revenue at the end of the most recent financial year

evByIc.def: Enterprise Value divided by invested capital of the last financial year

evCafFcf.def: Enterprise Value divided by free cash flow for the most recent financial year

lcpCafFcf.def: Market capitalisation of the company divided by free cash flow for the most recent financial year

priceCfoR.def: Market capitalisation of the company divided by cashflow from operations for the most recent financial year

priceBySales.def: Market cap of the stock divided by total revenue for the most recent financial year

pePremSi.def: Stock PE ratio divided by the corresponding sub-sector PE ratio minus one

pbPremSi.def: Stock PB ratio divided by the corresponding sub-sector PB ratio minus one

psPremSi.def: Stock PS ratio divided by the corresponding sub-sector PS ratio minus one

dyPremSs.def: Difference between the dividend yield of company and the corresponding sub-sector

indpe.def: Average PE ratio of the sector the stock belongs to

indpb.def: Average PB ratio of the sector the stock belongs to

inddy.def: Average dividend yield of the sector the stock belongs to

ttmPe.def: Close price divided by the TTM earnings per share, excluding extraordinary items. TTM stands for trailing twelve months

breco.def: Sum of analysts having a strong buy/buy rating divided by the total number of analysts

upside.def: Target price estimate for the stock divided by the close price minus one

nBreco.def: Sum of analysts having a strong buy/buy rating for the stock

pctHldReco.def: Sum of analysts having a hold rating divided by the total number of analysts

pctSelReco.def: Sum of analysts having a strong sell / sell rating divided by the total number of analysts

totalAnalysts.def: Total number of analysts covering the company

instown.def: Percentage of company's common stock held by mutual funds

instown3.def: Percentage change in MF ownership of the stock in last three months

chMutHldng6M.def: Percentage change in MF ownership of the stock in last six months

strown.def: Percentage of company's common stock held by promoters

strown3.def: Percentage change in promoter holding of the stock in last three months

chPromHldng6M.def: Percentage change in promoter holding of the stock in last six months

promShrPled.def: Promoter holdings pledged as a percentage of the total shares outstanding

domInstHldng.def: Percentage of company's common stock held by domestic institutions

domInstHldng3M.def: Percentage change in domestic inst. holding of the stock in last three months

domInstHldng6M.def: Percentage change in domestic inst. holding of the stock in last six months

forInstHldng.def: Percentage of company's common stock held by foreign institutions

forInstHldng3M.def: Percentage change in foreign inst. holding of the stock in last three months

forInstHldng6M.def: Percentage change in foreign inst. holding of the stock in last six months

insHolding.def: Percentage of company's common stock held by insurance firms

retailHolding.def: Percentage of company's common stock held by retail investors

insiderCml1M.def: Cumulative number of shares traded by insiders of the company over the previous 1 month as a % of total shares outstanding

insiderCml3M.def: Cumulative number of shares traded by insiders of the company over the previous 3 months as a % of total shares outstanding

insiderCml6M.def: Cumulative number of shares traded by insiders of the company over the previous 6 months as a % of total shares outstanding

bulkCml1M.def: Cumulative number of shares traded under bulk deals over the previous 1 month as a % of total shares outstanding

bulkCml3M.def: Cumulative number of shares traded under bulk deals over the previous 3 months as a % of total shares outstanding

bulkCml6M.def: Cumulative number of shares traded under bulk deals over the previous 6 months as a % of total shares outstanding

nShareholders.def: No. of unique DEMATS account with at least one share of the stock in their portfolio

valr.def: Percentile rank of the stock, based on the price momentum as well as valuation characteristics

prmr.def: Percentile rank of the stock, based on the price momentum characteristics

erqr.def: Earnings quality rank of the stock vs all the other stocks listed on NSE

ptir.def: Percentile rank of the stock, calculated based on the price to intrinsic value ratio

fundamental.def: Rank of the stock vs all others in the sector, based on different fundamental criteria

fair.def: Fair value of the stock future contract calculated using expected dividends and discount rate

ftcp.def: Future contract close price from the day the stock future contract was last traded

ftls.def: Minimum number of stock future/option contracts that can be purchased in one transaction

ftoi.def: Current month stock future contract open interest from the day stock future contract last traded

1Dfoi.def: Percentage change in current month stock future contract open interest in last 1 day

1Wfoi.def: Percentage change in current month stock future contract open interest in last 1 week

ftvol.def: Current month stock future contract Volume from the day stock future contract last traded

1Dvol.def: Percentage change in current month stock future contract volume in last 1 day

1Wvol.def: Percentage change in current month stock future contract volume in last 1 week

ftbas.def: Difference betweeen the price of the future contract and stock price in cash

fairsp.def: Difference between the last close price and fair value of the stock future contract

ccrp.def: Profit that can be made by entering into a cash and carry arbitrage position

rolc.def: Difference between the next and current month future price divided by the current month future price

rolp.def: An indication of how many current month futures contract have been rolled over to next month

csprd.def: Next month future contract close price minus current month future contract close price

opcoi.def: Sum of open interests of stock call option contracts for all the strikes

oppoi.def: Sum of open interests of stock put option contracts for all the strikes

1Dcoi.def: Percentage change in stock call option open interest in last 1 day

1DPoi.def: Percentage change in stock put option open interest in last 1 day

1Wcoi.def: Percentage change in stock call option open interest in last 1 week

1Wpoi.def: Percentage change in stock put option open interest in last 1 week

chstr.def: Strike price of the stock call option with the highest open interest

phstr.def: Strike price of the stock put option with the highest open interest

1Dceoi.def: Strike price of the stock call option with the highest 1 day change in open interest

1Dpeoi.def: Strike price of the stock put option with the highest 1 day change in open interest

1Wceoi.def: Strike price of the stock call option with the highest 1 week change in open interest

1Wpeoi.def: Strike price of the stock put option with the highest 1 week change in open interest

putcall.def: Total put open interest divided by the total call open interest

vWAP.def: Volume weighted average price from the day stock last traded

pab1Mma.def: Close price divided by the simple moving average of last 20 trading days price minus one

pab12Mma.def: Close price divided by the simple moving average of last 250 trading days price minus one

prAvMonthEVA.def: Close price divided by the exponential moving average of last 22 trading days price minus one

beta.def: Beta is a measure of a company's stock price volatility relative to the market

3Ywsh.def: Measure of excess return per unit of risk, calculated using 104 weekly price close points

3Ywal.def: Excess return of a stock relative to its benchmark, calculated using 104 weekly price close points

relVol.def: 10 days avg daily traded volume divided by the last 91 days avg daily traded volume

12mVol.def: Annualised standard deviation of the daily price change for the 200 most recent trading days

12mVolN.def: Annualised standard deviation of the stock minus annualized standard deviation of the Nifty

14dRsi.def: RSI measures the momentum of a stock to determine whether it is in overbought or oversold range

14ersi.def: Modified RSI based on exponential price averages, used to determine overbought & oversold zones

14adx.def: It indicates the strength of a trend, calculated as average between current and 14 days prior value

1mac.def: It is trend indicator calculated using difference between 12 and 26 day exponential price average

2mac.def: Difference between moving average convergence divergence indicator and signal line

priceUBB.def: Used to check richness in the price, calculated as close price / upper bollinger band - 1

priceLBB.def: Used to check cheapness in the price, calculated as close price / lower bollinger band - 1

parabolSAR.def: A trend indicator, calculated as close price divided by the parabolic SAR

williamR.def: Calculated using 14D lookback period, used to identify overbought/oversold zones

stochasticK.def: A momentum indicator used to identify overbought/oversold zones

stochasticD.def: 3D simple moving average of %K used to identify overbought/oversold zones

percentChangeObv.def: Percentage change in on balance voume in last 1 week

percentChangeADL.def: Percentage change in accumulation distribution line in last 1 week

superTrend.def: A trend following indicator used to generate buy/sell signals in trending market

ema10d.def: Exponential moving average of the price over last 10 trading days

sma10d.def: Simple moving average of the price over last 10 trading days

ema50d.def: Exponential moving average of the price over last 50 trading days

sma50d.def: Simple moving average of the price over last 50 trading days

ema100d.def: Exponential moving average of the price over last 100 trading days

ema200d.def: Exponential moving average of the price over last 200 trading days

sma100d.def: Simple moving average of the price over last 100 trading days

sma200d.def: Simple moving average of the price over last 200 trading days

maxDrawdown.def: Indicates the maximum fall in the value of the investment over the previous 1 year; measured as the percentage change between the lowest point and the highest point before the lowest point.

incTrev.def: Revenue generated by the company in the most recent financial year

incEbi.def: Gross profit minus operating cost for the latest financial year

incDep.def: Depreciation and amortization expense of the company for the latest financial year

incPbi.def: EBITDA minus depreciation and amortization expense for the latest financial year

incIoi.def: Interest expense and other related items for the most recent financial year

incPbt.def: PBIT minus interest and other related items for the latest financial year

incToi.def: Taxes paid for the most recent financial year

incNinc.def: PBT minus taxes paid by the company for the latest financial year

incEps.def: Net income divided by the total common shares outstanding of the company

incDps.def: Total dividend divided by the total common shares outstanding of the company

incPyr.def: Dividend per share divided by the earnings per share

incRaw.def: Expenses incurred on procuring raw materials

incPfc.def: Expenses incurred on using power & fuel

incEpc.def: Expenses incurred on employee wages & salaries

incSga.def: Expenses incurred on marketing, selling products & services and managing the company

incOpe.def: Other expenses incurred in operating the company like rent, servicing of machines, R&D etc

qIncTrevK.def: Revenue generated by the company in the most recent financial quarter

qIncNincK.def: Net income earned by the company in the most recent financial quarter

qIncEbiK.def: Gross profit minus operating cost for the latest financial quarter

qIncEpsK.def: Net income for the latest financial quarter divided by the total common shares outstanding of the company

qIncOpeK.def: Other expenses incurred in operating the company like rent, servicing of machines, R&D etc

qIncPbiK.def: EBITDA minus depreciation and amortization expense for the latest financial quarter

qIncPbtK.def: PBIT minus interest and other related items for the latest financial quarter

balCsti.def: It includes cash, cash equivalent and short term investments of the company

balTrec.def: It includes accounts, notes and other receivables of the company

balTinv.def: All assets held for sale in the ordinary course of business by the company

balTca.def: Sum of cash and equivalents, total receivables, total inventory and other current assets

balNppe.def: Gross property, plant and equipment minus accumulated depreciation

balGint.def: Sum of goodwill and intangibles like patents, copyrights, trademarks etc

balLti.def: Long term investments of the company at the end of latest financial year

balTota.def: Total assets of the company for the latest financial year

balAccp.def: Balance owed to suppliers for material and merchandise used in production

balTdep.def: Total deposits held by the bank at the end of the latest financial year

balTcl.def: Liabilities expected to be due in the next year/operating cycle of the company

balTltd.def: Long term debt and capital lease obligation of the company for the latest financial year

balTdeb.def: Total interest bearing debt of the company outstanding at the end of the most recent financial year

balDit.def: Difference between deferred tax liabilities and deferred tax assets of the company

balMint.def: Accumulated interest for minority shareholders in subsidiaries not wholly owned by the company

balTotl.def: Total liabilities of the company for the latest financial year

balComs.def: Common shares outstanding of the company multiplied by the par value, also known as Common Stock

balApic.def: Capital contributed by shareholders in excess of par value of common stock

balRtne.def: Residual earnings from operations not distributed to shareholders

balTeq.def: Sum of share capital, additional paid-in capital, reserves & surplus and other equity of the company

balTcso.def: Total common shares of the company outstanding at the end of the most recent financial year

cafCiwc.def: Change in working capital of the company for the latest financial year

cafCfoa.def: Cash flow attributed to normal business operations of the company for the latest financial year

cafCexp.def: Capital expenditure incurred by the company in the latest financial year

cafCfia.def: Cash flow attributed to investing activities of the latest financial year

cafTcdp.def: Total cash distributed as dividend to shareholders in the latest financial year

cafCffa.def: Cash flow attributed to financing activities of the latest financial year

cafNcic.def: Sum of operating cashflow, investing cashflow, financing cashflow and foreign exchange effects

balNca.def: Sum of long term assets like Property/Plant/Equipment, Goodwill & Intangibles, Long term investments etc

balNcl.def: Sum of long term debt, deferred tax liabilities & other long term liabilities

cafFcf.def: Operating cash flow remaining after deducting the capital expenditure for the latest financial year

balDta.def: Difference between deferred tax assets and deferred tax liabilities of the company

bookValue.def: Total value of a company’s assets that shareholders of the company will receive if the company gets liquidated

balOca.def: Uncommon / Atypical assets held by a company which can be quickly converted to cash

balOtha.def: Uncommon / Atypical assets held by a company which do not fall under major asset categories

balOcl.def: Uncommon immediate obligations outstanding for a company not under any major liability type

balOthl.def: Obligations outstanding for a company which do not fall under major liability categories

expenseRatio.def: The operating and administrative costs of running the fund measured as the percentage of fund assets

trackErr.def: The difference between the performance of the security and the benchmark index that it tracks
